meta.name: self-service-and-knowledge
meta.description: Builds the help center, in-product guidance, and knowledge base that let customers resolve problems without contacting anyone — content, findability, maintenance, and deflection measurement. Use this to build or fix a help center, reduce support volume, write documentation for customers, improve findability, or decide what deserves a help article versus a product fix.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建自助帮助中心，让客户自行解决常见问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果客户总为同样的问题反复咨询，需要一个自助知识库来减轻支持团队的负担。
copy.tagline_en: Build a self-service help center and knowledge base to cut support volume.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if customers ask the same questions and you need self-service docs to cut tickets.

howto.what: 该技能会引导你搭建/优化自助知识库:判断该写文档还是改产品,按联系量排优先级;文章围绕客户任务写,先给步骤、一篇一事、展示真实界面并写明求助路径;还强调从搜索日志和产品内提示提升可发现性,文档要有负责人与审核日期,并用联系量下降衡量成效。
howto.when: 当你为了降低客服联系量而要求搭建或改进帮助中心、为客户写帮助文档,或判断某问题该写文章还是修产品等需求时触发。

say.text: 某个页面总是让人困惑,该写帮助文章还是改产品?
say.note: 会先判断该问题该不该写文档。

say.text: 帮我把客服工单按话题排优先级,列出最值得写帮助文档的十个。
say.note: 会按联系量而非功能重要性排。

say.text: 查一下帮助中心的搜索日志,把搜不到结果的词列成内容待办。
say.note: 空结果查询会被当作待写主题。

howto.what_en: Framework for self-service help and knowledge: decide article vs product fix, rank by contact volume, write answer-first articles (one per task, real UI, human path); use search logs for findability, require owner/date; measure contact drop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or improve a help center, write customer docs, or decide if a problem needs an article or a product fix - often to lower support contacts.

say_en.text: A page confuses people; should I write a help article or fix the product?
say_en.note: It decides whether an article is warranted.

say_en.text: Prioritize support-ticket topics and list the top 10 for help articles.
say_en.note: Ranks by contact volume, not feature importance.

say_en.text: Check help-center logs for empty queries; list them as content backlog.
